# Majority Rule

*Share of bars that closed up over the last N, in percent.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Majority Rule** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `10` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/majority.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Majority Rule", shortTitle: "MR", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const length = input.int("Length", 10, { min: 1 });
const up = ta.calc([ta.change(candle.close, 1)], (d) => (d > 0 ? 1 : d === d ? 0 : NaN));
plot(ta.calc([ta.sum(up, length)], (s) => (s / length) * 100), { title: "Majority Rule", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(50, { title: "50", color: "#787B86", style: "dashed" });
```
